{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
filtered_data = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue'] != '999999.99')]

# Count filtered rows
print(f"Number of completed orders after filtering: {len(filtered_data)}")

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
filtered_data['revenue'] = filtered_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = filtered_data.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Print channel revenue
print(channel_revenue)

# Find the channel with highest revenue
max_revenue_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue'].idxmax()]
print(f"Channel with highest revenue: {max_revenue_channel['channel']} with ${max_revenue_channel['revenue']:,.2f}")"}
